Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain for 6 weeks. Jumped playing basketball hit and fell on knee.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
At the clinical marker, along the anterosuperomedial aspect of the knee, there is a soft tissue hematoma measuring approximately 3.4 x 0.7 x 4.8 cm (AP X TR X CC) interposed between subcutaneous soft tissue and the deep fascial layer (Morel-Lavallee lesion). Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Subcutaneous soft tissue hematoma along the anterosuperomedial aspect of the knee measuring approximately 3.4 x 0.7 x 4.8 cm, interposed between subcutaneous soft tissue and the deep fascial layer (Morel-Lavallee lesion). 
2.	No acute ligamentous, osseous, or meniscal injury.

-3-Plane Loc, Sag PD FS, Ax T2 FS, Cor T2 FS, Sag T1, Screen Save, Sag T2 FS

* Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
* Flattening of ACL slope and increased singal intensity, C/W ACL tear.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Hyperintensity foci of tibial intercondylar eminence on F/S T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
> Lateral tilting of patella. Mild fraying surface of articular cartilage of patella.
> Increased fat stranding of infrapatellar fat pad.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of medial femoral condyle and medial and lateral tibial plateau, in favor of chondromalacia.
> Mild joint effusion and medial patellar plicae. 
Impression:
1. C/W ACL tear.
2. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3. In favor of degeneration of tibial intercondylar eminence with bone marrow edema.
4. Mild osteoarthritis of left knee and grade 2 chondromalacia of left knee, major at medial compartment.

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Mild degenerative subchondral cystic changes are present at the anterior weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and at the anterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Mild, diffuse synovial proliferation. Moderate size Baker cyst. Small ganglion cyst also arises from the gastrocnemius origins bilaterally.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the posterior horn extending to the meniscal body. Mild extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is moderate cartilage thinning and irregularity diffusely. Small marginal osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a large, complex tear involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn, with maceration and moderate extrusion. A prominent radial tear is present at the junction of the body and posterior horn. A fragment is displaced centrally toward the intercondylar notch.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is marked, diffuse cartilage loss with large marginal osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate cartilage thinning and surface irregularity at the patella and trochlea diffusely. Moderate osteophytes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): The anterior cruciate ligament is diffusely degenerated. Both bundles are not well visualized, suggesting chronic partial tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Degenerated, intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
There is mild anterior soft tissue edema. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Medial and lateral meniscal tear. Maceration and extrusion of the lateral meniscus.
2. Tricompartmental osteoarthritis most prominent in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment.
3. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament with evidence of chronic partial tear.
4. Moderate joint effusion with synovial proliferation. Moderate Baker cyst.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteración de señal difusa de la médula ósea.

Condropatía rotuliana con úlceras grado 2 y 3.
